title: Thermacell Mosquito Repellent Refills; Provide 120 Hours of Protection; Contain 30 Repellent Mats, 10 Fuel Cartridges; Compatible with Any Fuel-Powered Mosquito Repeller Product
features: GENIUNE THERMACELL REFILLS FOR FUEL-POWERED REPELLERS: Only Genuine Thermacell refills are scientifically proven to work with Thermacell repellers to repel mosquitoes from a 15FT zone. Compatible with all Thermacell Fuel-ZoneGuard repellers. Includes 30 4-hour DEET-free repellent mats and 10 12-hour butane fuel cartridges. Packaging may vary.

EASY TO USE: Simply slide your Thermacell repellent mat under the grill, twist the butane fuel cartridge into place, and click 2-3 times to turn on your repeller. Repeller starts heating immediately with max protection in 15 minutes. Just switch the repeller to off when your are done. No need to clean up dead bugs afterwards.

15FT ZONE OF MOSQUITO PROTECTION: Proprietary formula provides a large, 15-ft protection zone of EPA registered mosquito repellent. No need to apply sticky DEET sprays or reapply to your yard throughout the season. Scent-free, no smoke, and no open flames.
PEOPLE AND PET FRIENDLY: Independently tested and EPA reviewed for safety & effectiveness. Repels tough mosquitoes. For outdoor use only.

100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEE: At Thermacell, we stand behind the performance and quality of our products. If you are not happy with your purchase, you may return it to us for repair, replacement or refund. Please contact service@thermacell.com.
